rows.name: baseName
rows.desc: Base name of the instance. The name of an instance can contain a vector expression by which baseName and numInst are derived. numInst can also be defined at creation.

rows.name: cellName
rows.desc: Cell name of the master for this instance.

rows.name: libName
rows.desc: Name of the library that contains the master for this instance.

rows.name: viewName
rows.desc: View name of the master for this instance.
